summary: Lexeo Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, reporting completion of its previously announced merger of Mantle Therapeutics Inc. under a September 16, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger, with Merger Sub merging into Mantle and Mantle surviving as a wholly owned Lexeo subsidiary. Consideration: $5.3 million cash plus $3.0 million in unregistered Lexeo common stock, subject to adjustments. Mantle restricted stock vested pre-close; SAFEs converted per liquidity-event provisions and convertible notes were paid off. Watch milestone/CVR economics, share overhang from the 4(a)(2) issuance, and any earnout funding obligations.
